WITH per_status AS (
    SELECT
        CENTROMEA,
        AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
        AVG(CASE WHEN `T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND CRE IS NOT NULL AND CRE <> 0 THEN `T-BIL` / CRE END) AS avg_ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14'
    GROUP BY CENTROMEA
), with_overall AS (
    SELECT *, AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS overall_avg_ratio
    FROM per_status
)
SELECT
    CENTROMEA,
    avg_hgb,
    avg_ratio,
    avg_ratio / overall_avg_ratio AS ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM with_overall
WHERE overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: A test with a missing or zero CRE has no defined T-BIL-to-CRE ratio and is excluded from that status's ratio average; missing HGB values are ignored by AVG.
